subject: POC launch plan and kickoff readout — LedgerBridge
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Bryant <kyle@ledgerbridge.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ledgerbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC launch plan and kickoff readout — LedgerBridge

Thanks for the time this morning, Kyle + Sarah — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC window and owners: 

1) Goal / success criteria (what success looks like for LedgerBridge)
- 95% intent-match on the customer support routing test set (30k messages)
- Sub-350ms median token latency at 2 RPS during simulated peak for the sampled flows
- No PII egress to hosted services; logs retained per your policy (30 days)

2) Proposed POC scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (kickoff): sandbox access, sample data ingest, runbook review
- Week 1–2: model integration + baseline eval against your test set
- Week 3: performance tuning (batching/kv-caching) and security checklist completion
- Week 4: final readout — results, learnings, go/no-go recommendation

3) Owners (we can update if you prefer different points of contact)
- Redwood: Sean (technical lead / escalation), Marissa (trial ops & success metrics), Camila (integration engineer)
- LedgerBridge: Kyle (product owner), Sarah (SRE/infra owner)

4) Immediate asks (this week)
- Kyle: confirm test set delivery format (CSV vs Parquet) and target delivery date (ideally by Thu 2028-04-13)
- Sarah: confirm VPC peering window & firewall rules for sandbox (approx 2 hours)
- LedgerBridge: sign the attached mutual action plan (spreadsheet) so we can allocate dedicated capacity

Attachments: LedgerBridge_POC_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes timeline, validation rubrics, and acceptance gates.

I'll drop a calendar invite for kickoff once we have your preferred kickoff day (suggest Wed 2028-04-12 or Mon 2028-04-17).

Short note: if the 4-week window is too tight, we can stretch to 6 wks but would like to keep the same acceptance gates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Kyle Bryant <kyle@ledgerbridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ledgerbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch plan and kickoff readout — LedgerBridge

Appreciate the clear write-up, Sean. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The test set will be Parquet (we'll drop a sanitized slice to S3 by EOD Friday 2028-04-14).
- We'd prefer the kickoff on Mon 2028-04-17 at 10am PT so our infra lead can join.
- For acceptance: can we add a qualitative assessment step during Week 3 where our CS reps validate a 200-message sample for answer relevance? We want to avoid a purely numeric gate.

We're comfortable with the 4-week window if the qualitative check is included. I'll start the internal approval to sign the mutual action plan and get back when it's countersigned.

Also — we need encryption-at-rest confirmation for any logs pulled into the sandbox. Sarah, can you confirm whether you need us to provide a specific KMS key?

Thanks,
Kyle
Product Lead, LedgerBridge
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Bryant <kyle@ledgerbridge.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ledgerbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch plan and kickoff readout — LedgerBridge

Internal note: adding the qualitative CS review in Week 3 is a good ask — adding a row to the mutual action plan for that acceptance gate now. I've attached a trimmed runbook PDF for our sandbox steps and a copy of the mutual action plan with the new gate.

Action items for Redwood ops:
- Camila: prepare sample integration checklist and IAM roles before kickoff (target 2028-04-16)
- Sean: confirm capacity reservation for the 4-week run (we can request 2 x A100-equivalent burst nodes)
- Marissa: I'll own the final readout template and drive the Week 4 slide pack

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (runbook excerpt), LedgerBridge_POC_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (updated)

I'll put placeholder calendar invites for kickoff and weekly 30-min check-ins (Mon 10am PT, weekly) — we can update once Kyle confirms.

—Marissa
Trial Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Bryant <kyle@ledgerbridge.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ledgerbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch plan and kickoff readout — LedgerBridge

Thanks Kyle — Monday 2028-04-17 at 10am PT works on our side. Calendar invite sent. Couple quick confirmations before kickoff: 

- Parquet test set delivery: please share S3 path + IAM user for access (we'll spin up a short-lived role if you prefer).
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS; Sarah, if you want to provide a key ARN we'll ensure logs/artifacts are encrypted with it.
- Weekly cadence: Mon 10am PT, 30 minutes. Week 4 readout slot requested for Tue 2028-05-14 11am PT (target final readout) — Marissa will circulate the readout template next week.

Deliverables before kickoff (due 2028-04-16):
- LedgerBridge: sanitized Parquet test set in S3 (Kyle)
- LedgerBridge: KMS key ARN if you require CMK (Sarah)
- Redwood: sandbox credentials and integration checklist (Camila)
- Redwood: reserved capacity request (Sean)

If any of those dates are tight, say so and we'll adjust. Otherwise we'll proceed to lock the schedule and I will mark the HubSpot deal with the POC start date.

Looking forward — see you Monday.

—Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
